reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that polls the OpenCode Go usage endpoint and presents per-key quota windows, reset times, and rate-limit status in a floating dashboard.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中实时显示各个 OpenCode Go API 密钥的滚动、周度和月度用量及重置时间。
summaries.en: Displays real-time rolling, weekly, and monthly OpenCode Go usage, reset times, and rate-limit status for each configured API key in a DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Reads OpenCode Go API keys from the DSH credentials configuration
Sends authenticated requests to the OpenCode usage endpoint
Displays rolling, weekly, and monthly quota usage for configured keys in a web interface
